"""Replay one cue-ball export to a scratch directory without saving source."""
import bpy,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
source=Path(bpy.data.filepath);expected='6b06dedf3da537c411afc7c6c4589268fb6945e4dfd22e8af4ed35a5abc71672';assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
out=Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--')+1]).resolve();assert out!=source.parent/'exports';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
root=bpy.data.objects['ASSET_Ball_00'];bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT');root.select_set(True)
for ob in root.children_recursive:ob.select_set(True)
root.location=(0,0,0)
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(out/'ball_00.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,export_apply=True)
reference=(source.parent/'exports/ball_00.glb').read_bytes();actual=(out/'ball_00.glb').read_bytes();assert actual==reference,'Current source export differs from published standalone'
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(input_source_sha256=expected,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),bytes=len(actual),exact_standalone_replay=True,source_and_product_files_unchanged=True),indent=2)+'\n')
diagnosis: Only index submission order differs. Full JSON and all position/normal/UV bytes match; all3968 oriented triangles including multiplicity match. Preserve raw failed attempt, then use canonical oriented-triangle equality uniformly, without changing the model.
